  Pepé Le Pew is a cartoon character from the Warner Bros.  Looney Tunes  and  Merrie Melodies  series of cartoons, introduced in 1945. Depicted as an anthropomorphic French striped skunk , Pepé is constantly in search of love and romance, but his offensive odor and often forceful kissing typically cause other characters to run away from him. He usually pursues a cat who has accidentally had a white stripe painted on her back and tail. [ 1 ]  

  Pepé Le Pew has been criticized by a vocal few  [  citation needed  ]  for portraying the pursuit and harassment of unwilling female characters as comedy, with his behavior often interpreted as stalking or implying sexual assault . His exaggerated accent, mannerisms, and romantic behavior have also been criticized by some  [  citation needed  ]  for reinforcing national and cultural stereotypes of French men as overly amorous and sexually aggressive.
